calls.statement:
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, fully_loaded
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT 
  dp.sku,
  dp.product_name,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales,
  SUM(fsl.gross_amount) as gross_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 5
  AND fsl.staff_purchase_flag = false
GROUP BY dp.sku, dp.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 10
